title: Re-requesting randomness from VRF is a security anti-pattern
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as the VRF service provider has control over who wins the game  **Likelihood:** High, as there is an incentive for a VRF provider to exploit this and it is not hard to do from his side  ## Description  The `forceHoneyJarSearch` method is used to "kick off another VRF request", as mentioned in its NatSpec.
